slot_scores.name: no_borrowing_cash_only
slot_scores.evidence_quote: When funds from a maturing investment are received at the end of a year, are they immediately available to be invested in products available at the beginning of the next year?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent touched the cash-availability mechanics (whether matured proceeds can be reinvested) but never explicitly asked whether borrowing is allowed or confirmed the cash-only restriction central to this slot.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Investment at the beginning of any year cannot exceed the cash available at that time (no borrowing; only cash on hand and matured proceeds can be invested).
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent never asked whether borrowing was permitted; it listed the cash-only/no-borrowing constraint in its confirmed understanding as if established rather than marking it as an assumption needing confirmation.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The agent moved to READY_TO_MODEL without ever asking the key P1 question about borrowing / cash-only investing; H1 remains only partially covered, so an unresolved P1 slot remained at the stopping point.

summary: The agent asked several useful questions about caps, timing, integrality, and other constraints, but never addressed the no-borrowing / cash-only restriction (H1), silently absorbing it into its READY_TO_MODEL understanding and stopping with this P1 slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
